schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_assets" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_participant_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_series_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_type_collections" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "parent_id" UUID,
  "tenant_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "series_id" UUID,
  "type_id" UUID,
  "place_id" UUID,
  "description" TEXT,
  "start_date" TIMESTAMP,
  "end_date" TIMESTAMP,
  "status" TEXT DEFAULT 'scheduled',
  "round" INTEGER,
  "metadata" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT,
  "source" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_assets" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" TEXT,
  "event_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "asset_id" UUID NOT NULL,
  "relationship" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_participants" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" TEXT,
  "event_id" UUID,
  "profile_id" UUID,
  "role" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "placement" INTEGER,
  "group_id" TEXT,
  "metadata" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT,
  "source" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_series" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "type_id" UUID,
  "organizer_id" UUID,
  "description" TEXT,
  "start_date" TIMESTAMP,
  "end_date" TIMESTAMP,
  "recurrence" TEXT,
  "metadata" TEXT,
  "external_id" TEXT,
  "source" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_types" (
  "id" UUID PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  "slug" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  "_meta_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "_meta_data" JSON,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp,
  "tenant_id" TEXT,
  "name" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "description" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "schema" TEXT DEFAULT '',
  "participant_schema" TEXT DEFAULT ''
);
